items.title: Michigan Bills Would Require Data Centers to Pay Their Own Power and Community Costs
items.dek: Democrats' package mandates 15- to 20-year contracts, 90% clean energy, and binding local agreements so residents do not cover water, electricity, or decommissioning expenses.
items.judge_note: Concrete legislative package with specific mandates (15-20 year contracts, 90% clean energy, cost-shifting provisions) — a real filing/proposal, not just talk.
